title: Dealer Rate Markup Cap on Vehicle Purchase Agreements Installment Contracts
content:
**Rule.** On a dealer-arranged installment contract under the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**, the contract APR may exceed the lender's buy rate by no more than the deal type's markup cap in percentage points. A contract whose markup would exceed the cap is written at the buy rate plus the cap. Cash, outside-lender and fleet net-terms deals carry no dealer-arranged APR, and this rule does not apply to them. When a lender approves at a different buy rate, the cap is applied again to the new buy rate.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, a deal type with a 2.0-point cap)

| Lender buy rate | Proposed contract APR | Contract written at |
|---|---|---|
| 7.10 percent | 8.60 percent | 8.60 percent (markup 1.5 points, within the cap) |
| 7.10 percent | 9.40 percent | 9.10 percent (buy rate plus the 2.0-point cap) |
| 7.90 percent (new buy rate on the lender's approval) | 10.20 percent | 9.90 percent (cap applied again to the new buy rate) |

| Payment arrangement | Markup cap applies |
|---|---|
| dealer-arranged installment contract | yes |
| cash, outside lender, fleet net terms | no |
